description:
What the OWOX Data Marts Bank of Canada connector loads: the daily exchange rates the Bank of Canada publishes, in one table. The connector reads the Valet API group of daily foreign exchange rates (`FX_RATES_DAILY`) and writes one row per currency pair per day.

The rate is the number of Canadian dollars for one unit of the foreign currency, so `USDCAD` is Canadian dollars per US dollar. There is nothing to join: the table carries no key that points at another table, and a rate is joined to your own data by `date` and the currency in `label`.
questions: What was the US dollar worth in Canadian dollars on each day of the last year?
Which currencies moved the most against the Canadian dollar this month?
How would last quarter's foreign-currency sales look converted to Canadian dollars at the rate of each sale's date?

Exchange Rates.description:
Daily foreign exchange rates published by the Bank of Canada, one row per currency pair per `date`. `label` is the pair as the connector names it: the Valet series name without its leading `FX`, for example `USDCAD` from the series `FXUSDCAD`. `rate` is Canadian dollars per one unit of the foreign currency.

The Bank publishes on business days, so weekends and holidays have no rows. Join it to your own data on `date` and the currency in `label`, and fill the gaps with the last earlier rate.
questions: What was the rate of each currency against the Canadian dollar on a given day?
How did the US dollar rate change from one month to the next over the last year?
Which dates in the last month have no rate, and what was the last published rate before each?
